measurement.name: source-structural-mccabe-v1
measurement.notClaim: Not a full control-flow graph proof or equivalence to every compiler plugin.
measurement.match: Expanded pattern paths minus one; add conservative unmatched exit unless unconditional wildcard/default exists.
measurement.catch: Same path rule when catch cases are present.
measurement.nestedClosures: Include decisions in owning body; report lambda/partial function separately; do not add closure base twice.
measurement.namedNestedDefinitions: Report separately, no nested body counted twice.
measurement.initialization: Report each primary/object initializer and field independently. Abstract declarations have no executable body.
measurement.nesting: Control constructs only; an else-if continuation retains the enclosing if level.

domain.description: Same full forbidden set as the aggregate-rules-formal v3 policy, unchanged; application/infrastructure imports are banned; fixed 5/2 maxima without exceptions.

boundary.appliesTo: app/**/application/** and app/**/infrastructure/** and app/net/** (the shared-common supply)
boundary.description: Projection apply-event contract layer: the generated kernel pure-function family translates judged events into view rows with zero mechanism — PO unpacking, Await and all IO stay in the glue shell (ViewMachine), which never back-flows into kernel. Per the candidate ruling of 2026-11-19 the boundary face admits exactly the projection family's declared time and identity vocabulary (java.time.Instant as the projection time type and java.util.UUID through the net.imadz.common.Id alias) and named-argument syntax as the emptyRow/copy idiom; kernel isolation and the direction-aware import policy are unchanged.
forbiddenDelta: Term names Instant and UUID are admitted as the declared projection time/identity face; Random, Clock, LocalDateTime, Date and Await stay banned — the single sanctioned clock read is the ts epoch0 normalization, pinned by a structural property to that helper alone.

Named-argument syntax is admitted at the boundary: scalameta parses it as Term.Assign, so the Term.Assign mutable-state violation fires in domain mode only; Defn.Var stays banned in both layers, so no assignment target can exist at the boundary and the surviving Term.Assign shape is the emptyRow/copy named-argument idiom.

Direction-aware imports: an application file must not import infrastructure packages (kernel isolation); an infrastructure file may import application and infrastructure packages; every other banned import prefix (including java.time/java.util as import statements — fully-qualified type references are the sanctioned zero-import form) stays banned in both directions.
stillRejected: mutable collection names and mutation term names
boundary.exceptions: Exact file/owner/kind with finite maxima and justification. No whole-file exemption or project average.

support.description: No forbidden structural checks; 5/2 default with exact closed-dispatch exceptions.
